rationale: Both implementations passed all 10 acceptance cases, including concurrency and slow-trickle deadline checks. The Guion source uses bounded parallel_map and a request timeout; Python uses ThreadPoolExecutor and an explicit monotonic response deadline. The seven-pair measurement for the related health-digest case favored Guion on observed runtime. This is specific to this workload, not a causal or language-wide claim.

timing.context: Process and oracle-check time included; fixture setup excluded. Guion source cache bypassed; OS cache uncontrolled.
